post.summary: Sign in using mobile and password
post.description: Iran-only ten-digit mobile starting with 9. Persian/Arabic digits are normalized and outer whitespace is trimmed; 09, +98, separators and other prefixes are rejected. Password is never trimmed. Creates a server-side session with a fifteen-minute inactivity timeout and an absolute eight-hour lifetime. If the browser presents a valid authenticated session, successful sign-in revokes it. Sets a nonpersistent Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax __Host-BearStudio-Pilot cookie. Unknown/inactive/locked accounts and incorrect passwords share the same generic 401 response. Rate limit: five requests per remote IP/minute; account lockout: five password failures for fifteen minutes.

post.description: Cap 1000 projects. Require the slug of an existing service, a ready project poster ID or a direct HTTPS poster URL, and a full film or an external Watch link. Full film and optional preview each accept a ready managed video ID or safe direct HTTPS MP4 URL; require a unique current slug. No query. Writes require CSRF and fresh transactional actor/stamp/active/permission checks under the shared exclusive administration lock; no fifteen-minute login recency. Responses use no-store. Direct HTTPS video URLs must have a case-insensitive .mp4 path suffix; query/fragment do not affect the suffix rule, and no URL is fetched. Set isFeatured to select the project for Home. It defaults to false.

post.summary: Upload one bounded image and normalize to WebP
post.description: Mutations require CSRF, current actor/stamp/permission and the common transaction-owned EXCLUSIVE BearStudio.AccessAdministration lock (5s wait); no fifteen-minute login recency. References, reservations and bounded audit commit atomically. No query. Exactly one multipart file and one context field are required. Raw<=profile.size and10MiB; full request<=10MiB+64KiB. Validate actual JPEG/PNG/WebP, max12000 per input dimension/max16MP; fully decode/rotate, center-crop and resize EXACT profile size without upscaling. Encode WebP85 with stripped metadata, output<=min(profile.size,8MiB). Center crop a separate thumbnail for each image context using current thumbnail dimensions. Store both WebP files under the context directory, with the thumbnail in its thumbnail subdirectory. Read the effective profile for the upload context before processing. Recheck the actor, live cleanup intent and selected profile under the common exclusive lock before admission. If the selected image profile or thumbnail dimensions differ, return 409 SETTINGS_CHANGED. No SQL lock during receive/decode. Durable intent + metadata-first reconciliation protect committed files from cleanup; no user paths or original bytes retained. All responses use no-store.

201.description: Upload one bounded image and normalize to WebP

429.description: At most two simultaneous uploads; no waiting queue. Admission rejects before multipart buffering/decoding. This is a concurrency limit, not a requests-per-minute window.

value.message: Too many requests. Try again later.

get.description: Only page is accepted, once. Fixed page size of 24 with items and total. Order by newest creation first, then ID. No paths/original filenames. All responses use no-store.

post.description: Send one multipart video/mp4 file plus a generated thumbnail or a legacy ready video-context posterId. Legacy callers can also send a raw MP4 without a thumbnail. The MP4 limit is configured through Media:MaximumVideoBytes (1024 to 104857600 bytes, default 100 MiB). The optional generated thumbnail is at most 1 MiB; multipart overhead has an additional 64 KiB allowance. Web stores the MP4 bytes unchanged and writes the normalized WebP thumbnail next to it under the same video ID. Private staging enforces limits even without Content-Length. Uploads and intents expire after fifteen minutes. Bounded MP4 container checks reject empty, truncated, or mismatched data. The endpoint admits one complete upload at a time. Finalization rechecks the actor, live intent, and any legacy poster under the exclusive administration lock. An ambiguous commit reconciles ready ownership before cleanup. Requires media.write and CSRF. Responses use no-store.

429.description: At most one complete upload; no waiting queue. Rejected before reading/staging the body. Retry-After is seconds.

delete.summary: Logically delete an unreferenced immutable image
delete.description: Requires media.write, CSRF and fresh transactional actor/stamp/active/permission checks under the common exclusive administration lock; no fifteen-minute recency. No query or body; any nonempty body returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. Current article covers, project posters, service images, Home image roles and approach cards, and light/dark logos cause 409 IMAGE_IN_USE. Atomically remove ready metadata and add durable cleanup intent/audit; commit before physical purge. A 204 acknowledges logical deletion, not immediate physical removal. A repeated authorized delete may drain its existing intent; unknown image/intent 404. Responses use no-store.

delete.description: Current project film/preview and Home video references block deletion with VIDEO_IN_USE. put.description: First save creates the singleton. Later saves replace its complete current content. Approach must contain exactly four cards in presentation order. About posters continue to use ready article, project or service images. Hero poster and Why image alt text derive from the Hero description and Why title. Validate ready image and MP4 sources. post.summary: Drain at most twenty persisted image cleanup intents
post.description: Mutations require CSRF, current actor/stamp/permission and the common transaction-owned EXCLUSIVE BearStudio.AccessAdministration lock (5s wait); no fifteen-minute login recency. References, reservations and bounded audit commit atomically. No query. At most20 intents; common exclusive lock and metadata-first ownership reconciliation. Never delete a committed owner's file or create a blind compensating intent after ambiguous commit. No scheduled worker required. All responses use no-store. Request body is forbidden; any nonempty body returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

200.description: Drain at most twenty persisted image cleanup intents

post.description: At most 20 eligible persisted intents, fair lastAttemptAt/creation/ID order. Uploads eligible only after the 15 minute expiry; deletes immediate. Owner metadata protects all files; stale owned intent clears only its intent. Preserve durable failures for retry; no permanent worker. Writes require CSRF and fresh transactional actor/stamp/active/permission checks under the shared exclusive administration lock; no fifteen-minute login recency. Responses use no-store. No query or request body; any nonempty body is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.
